decisions.statement: A collection stating no title is titled Trip.
A trip's stops are the locations naming this collection by page type and slug.
A stop is drawn in scheduled order, and an unscheduled stop is drawn first.
At most a thousand stops are drawn, and the page says so where more match.
A collection nothing names says so rather than drawing an empty list.
No map is drawn here, and the map route draws every location instead.

definition: one location collection and the locations naming it, listed as that trip's stops
